parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Record
parameters.description: The user-defined input parameters for debugging the playbook.

parameters.name: Taskflow
parameters.description:
The XML configuration of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybook](~~DescribePlaybook~~) operation to obtain this configuration.
